## Purpose / 目的

## Compatibility and scope / 兼容性与范围

ABI, source/wrappers and documentation impact / 说明 ABI、源码封装及文档影响。

## Validation / 验证

Actual commands, outcomes and limitations; distinguish skipped tests.
实际命令、结果与限制，不将跳过计入通过。

## Checklist / 检查

- [ ] No secrets, customer data, runtimes or weights / 无秘密、客户数据、运行库或权重
- [ ] Relevant tests, ownership and failure paths checked / 核相关测试、拥有权与失败分支
- [ ] English/Chinese user documentation synchronized / 中英文说明同步
- [ ] Upstream notices preserved and new dependencies declared / 保留声明并列新增依赖
